out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Plan & Specifications Submission - Remodeling, Change of Type, Change of Operation
violations.observation: PLUMBING APPLICATION WAS NOT COMPLETED (CORRECTIONS REQUIRED SENT BACK ON 1/9/26) AND AN AMENDMENT WAS NOT SUBMITTED TO THE HEALTH DEPARTMENT FROM THE LAST INSPECTION FOR THREE-VAT SINK PLUMBING AND GREASE TRAP INSTALLATION.
violations.corrective_action: The permit applicant needs to submit the following documents to the Health Department for review and approval: FINISH PLUMBING APPLICATION AND AN AMENDMENT TO THE HEALTH DEPARTMENT FOR THREE-VAT SINK CORRECTION AND GREASE TRAP INSTALLATION. PLEASE CONTACT THE HEALTH DEPARTMENT AT 703-246-2201 IF YOU NEED ASSISTANCE. PIC UNDERSTANDS PLUMBING APPLICATION MUST BE FULLY SUBMITTED AND AN AMENDMENT SHOULD BE SUBMITTED TO THE HEALTH DEPARTMENT AS SOON AS POSSIBLE ALONG WITH THAT PLUMBING CORRECTIONS. FAILURE TO DO SO WILL PREVENT WILL PREVENT THE ESTABLISHMENT FROM RENEWING HEALTH DEPARTMENT PERMIT FOR 2027.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Design/Install per Law
violations.observation: The plumbing system serving this food service facility has not been designed, constructed, and installed according to the Plumbing Code. OBSERVED THREE- VAT SINK WITHOUT AIR-GAPS OR AIR BREAKS AND THE GABAGE DISPOSAL INSTALLED AT THE WASH COMPARTMENT.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be designed, constructed, and installed according to Law. PIC UNDERSTANDS PLUMBING APPLICATION MUST BE FULLY SUBMITTED AND AN AMENDMENT SHOULD BE SUBMITTED TO THE HEALTH DEPARTMENT AS SOON AS POSSIBLE ALONG WITH THE PLUMBING CORRECTIONS AND GREASE TRAP INSTALLATION (ONCE PLUMBING PERMIT AND AMENDMENT HAVE BEEN APPROVED). FAILURE TO DO SO WILL PREVENT WILL PREVENT THE ESTABLISHMENT FROM RENEWING HEALTH DEPARTMENT PERMIT FOR 2027.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. OBSERVED Y SPLITTER INSTALLED AT THE MOP SINK.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. PIC WILL ENSURE THE Y SPLITTER IS REMOVED AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

out_items.name: Sewage and waste water properly disposed

violations.title: Sewage Disposal System, Approved
violations.observation: A review of the menu finds that the facility is producing grease in quantities likely to contribute to the production of grease-laden wastewater. Therefore, the wastewater from warewashing is required to go through a grease trap. THE ESTABLISHMENT HAS NOT INSTALLED GREASE TRAP STILL. PLUMBING APPLICATION PERMIT WAS SENT BACK FOR CORRECTIONS ON 1/9/26. NO AMENDMENT WAS SUBMITTED TO THE HEALTH DEPARTMENT.
violations.corrective_action: Sewage shall be conveyed to the point of disposal through an approved sanitary sewage system or other system including use of sewage transport vehicles, waste retention tanks, pumps, pipes, hoses, and connections that are constructed, maintained, and operated according to Law. PIC UNDERSTANDS PLUMBING APPLICATION MUST BE FULLY SUBMITTED AND AN AMENDMENT SHOULD BE SUBMITTED TO THE HEALTH DEPARTMENT AS SOON AS POSSIBLE. FAILURE TO DO SO WILL PREVENT WILL PREVENT THE ESTABLISHMENT FROM RENEWING HEALTH DEPARTMENT PERMIT FOR 2027.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Design/Install per Law
violations.observation: The plumbing system serving this food service facility has not been designed, constructed, and installed according to the Plumbing Code. OBSERVED THREE- VAT SINK WITHOUT AIR-GAPS OR AIR-BREAKS AND THE GARBAGE DISPOSAL INSTALLED STILL.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be designed, constructed, and installed according to Law. PIC HAS SUBMITTED PLANS. PLEASE ENSURE THE THREE- COMPARTMENT SINK CONFIGURATION IS CORRECTED BY JANUARY 4TH. IF YOU HAVE ANY QUESTIONS, PLEASE CONTACT THE EHS.
